vcu_g_153_200020b0.name: vehicle_stage_active_lo
vcu_g_153_200020b0.description: 153 build only. Low 5-bit field of the packed stage code in DAT_20001c76 (vehicle_revolution_state_v153 in data_vehicle_batch30): (code & 0x3f) >> 1, range 0..31. Rewritten every tick by vcu_revolution_stage_tracker (VCU_153 0x08004fc4). The high and middle fields are at 0x200020a8 and 0x200020ac (data_vehicle_batch30). Probably a mode or step index; the consumer is not traced. The shifts suggest a 16-bit code, while batch30 types DAT_20001c76 as u8 (to check).

vcu_g_153_200020b4.name: vehicle_stage_request
vcu_g_153_200020b4.description: 153 build only. The requested stage code DAT_20001f32 in three parts, count 3: [0] = code >> 10 (6 bits), [1] = (code & 0x3ff) >> 6 (4 bits), [2] = (code & 0x3f) >> 1 (5 bits). Rewritten every tick by vcu_revolution_stage_tracker, which copies DAT_20001f32 into the active code when that code is 0 or a reset is requested. Probably the requested step that vehicle_stage_active_lo follows.

vcu_g_0159_200021c5.name: vehicle_burst_count
vcu_g_0159_200021c5.description: Burst counter of vcu_sensor_threshold_pulse_count (0159 0x08007ecc). It increments when the debounce latch DAT_200021c4 sets and wraps at 10, so the value is 0..9. A nonzero value opens a 300-tick window; while the PB12 input is active low, bursts 3, 5, 8 and 9 send the messages with commands 0x3A, 0x1F, 0x3B and 0x20, then the counter resets. Probably counts sustained high readings of the sensor.

vcu_g_0159_200021ce.name: vehicle_led_chan_mask
vcu_g_0159_200021ce.description: Bits 0..7 of the 9-channel LED mask: bit n-1 is channel n (1..8). Set or cleared per channel by vcu_chan_mask_update (0159 0x0800aa9c) and set or cleared as a whole by led_frame_set_group_all (0x0800be30, 0x00 or 0xFF). Channel 0 is bit 0 of lighting_led_image_cf (data_lighting_batch16). Bytes 0x200021c6..0x200021d5 form the LED image sent to the driver. Meaning (lamp or output enable) probably.

vcu_g_0159_200021d0.name: vehicle_led_chan_mask_shadow
vcu_g_0159_200021d0.description: Second copy of the LED channel mask (bits 0..7 = channels 1..8, same order as vehicle_led_chan_mask), updated in the same two functions. Probably the shadow or pending copy used when the LED image is built. Channel 9 is bit 0 of 0x200021d1, owned by data_display_batch08.

vcu_g_0159_20003346.name: vehicle_sensor_raw
vcu_g_0159_20003346.description: Three raw 16-bit sensor words (index 0..2), stored by vcu_sensor_limit_derate_eval (0x08003594) from the readers app_get_u16_2000329c, _2000329e and _200032a0 before scaling. They are scaled by 1/14 (1/15 when DAT_20001feb is set) for the limit and derate ramps. Copied into the telemetry record at 0x20003372..0x20003376, and those 6 bytes are passed as the payload of a reply by vcu_ninebot_frame_dispatch.

vcu_g_0159_20003356.name: vehicle_can_tx_shadow
vcu_g_0159_20003356.description: Two 16-bit shadow copies of outgoing CAN payload words. Word 0 (0x20003356) is set from DAT_20001f90 (vehicle_derate_word) when can_get_tx_payload_for_id (0159 0x0800b770) builds the 0x100 frame; word 1 (0x20003358) is set from the 0x301 frame when it is built. Both are copied into the telemetry record at 0x20003388 and 0x2000338a.
